Close the page, then say the point.

Rereading feels like learning because the words look familiar. The real test is saying the main point with the page shut.

1. Pick the last thing you read.
2. Close it.
3. Say the main point in one sentence.
4. Stuck? Reopen, find the gap, try again.

You kept it if you can say it with the page closed.

#learning #productivity
